verdict.rationale: Angular ships an official CLI with a command that "Creates a new Angular workspace" and another that "Builds and serves your application, rebuilding on file changes". The README advertises "Get started in 5 minutes", and an in-browser tutorial gives a no-setup option. Together these cover both the scaffolding and the running parts of the story, from first-party sources only. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the few-minutes setup time, and fuller installation and quickstart detail in the docs beyond one-line command descriptions.
